verdict.rationale: Jan is itself a built-in AI assistant. Its docs say you can "give Jan a task and it works on it autonomously — files, commands, and web research" and describe autonomous agents that read files, manage calendars and take actions. Delegation is also supported by custom task-specific assistants, MCP-based agentic tool use with per-call approval panels, and browser automation via Jan Browser MCP. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomous task mode, and in-depth docs on how delegated tasks are planned, tracked and completed (the autonomy claims are one-line marketing statements).
